messages:
alyssa: FYI customer (ACME / proj p-8df7) is getting 429s even though their project tile shows ~80% available. Started around 2026-03-16T18:10Z.

alyssa: example API response:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\n{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded", "retry_after": 32}\n
sahil: can you paste the x-request-id and any rate-limit headers from the response?

alyssa: req-id: 0a1b2c3d, headers from response: x-rate-limit-remaining: 0, x-rate-limit-reset: 2026-03-16T18:12:14Z. Request headers had x-project-id: p-8df7, x-org-id: org-22.

noah: I pulled the meter-agg logs for org-22 + p-8df7 around that time. Quick read: the ledger shows project tokens available but the enforcement service decremented from the org shared pool instead and hit 0 first. Means enforcement path selected org pool before project bucket refresh.

marco: finance checked invoicing — usage/billing counts are normal for the day (delta ~0.02%). This looks like enforcement / visibility discrepancy not billing miscount.

sahil: ok. repro steps we should try: hammer the completion endpoint with short prompts until 429. Do you have a curl snippet?

alyssa: repro that consistently in prod & staging. snippet:

```
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/complete \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
    -H "x-project-id: p-8df7" -H "x-org-id: org-22" \
    -d '{"input":"hi"}' -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"
  sleep 0.15
done
```

alyssa: using the above we hit 429 after ~73 requests. Dashboard still shows project tile at ~80% until 18:30 reset time.

noah: hypothesis: rolling-window aggregator (used by dashboards) and the enforcement path are reading different sources/alignments. Dashboard uses the rounded rolling window computed in meter-agg with 5m compaction, enforcement reads live shard counters that were affected by a recent deploy that shifted shard epoch by -900s (15m). Result: enforcement saw token consumption earlier.

sahil: that would explain 429 while tile looks available. Is this a shard clock/offset bug or a race on the project->org fallback logic?

noah: looks like both: 1) shard epoch change moved enforcement boundary, 2) enforcement path prefers org pool if project lookup returns stale cache (TTL 10s). If project ledger hadn't refreshed, enforcement popped org pool instead.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0423 (P2) — assigned to @sahil, @noah, @marco. Slack thread linked.

marco: short-term mitigation ideas:
- flip org enforcement to conservative (prefer project bucket if present) on affected shard
- increase project ledger refresh frequency for the org for 1h
- run a quick backfill recompute of rolling counts for org-22 from 18:00-18:30

sahil: I can push a conservative fallback flag to the affected shard: RATE_LIMIT_PREFER_PROJECT=true. Will do canary in 3 mins and watch for 429s.

alyssa: thanks — please post the canary results here. Customer accepts short outage for fix, but wants ETA and root cause.

noah: started backfill job now: meter-agg recompute for org-22 window 18:00-18:30. ETA ~ 12m. I also confirm shard epoch offset from last deploy was -15m for the group that serves org-22.

sahil: canary rolled 2 mins ago to 2 nodes. Early signal: 429s stopped for a repro run (same curl). Rolling this to full shard in 6 mins if stable.

marco: after we stabilize, we'll run an audit for other orgs served by same shard and check for any invoice / usage reporting differences. Also want a short postmortem: root cause: shard epoch drift + enforcement fallback race.

alyssa: customer notified: ETA ~20m, applied temporary mitigation. thx team.

noah: followups:
- revert the deploy that introduced epoch shift or fix epoch calculation in rollout code (owner deploy-team)
- add a small end-to-end test to ensure dashboard/meter/ enforcement align across rolling-window boundaries
- increase project ledger cache TTL awareness in enforcement (atomic read of project+org counters)

sahil: assigning action owners in INC-2026-0423. I'll keep thread updated as we finish rollouts and backfill.

alyssa: confirmed with customer after canary — 429s stopped. Marking resolved for now, waiting on postmortem. :thumbsup:
